roadmap.title: Act I — the search begins
roadmap.description: Complete A Wintery Morning, The Cursed Manor and A Masquerade Night while sweeping each level's upgrade vials; check the checkpoint map for any vial you leave behind.

roadmap.title: Act II — moors, maze and manor
roadmap.description: Clear Craghill Moors, The Thorny Hedge Maze, Heatherwood Hall and The Prince's Dream. These are the longest early levels, so use the checkpoint map to track leftover vials.

roadmap.title: Act III — forests and gardens
roadmap.description: Clear Moonlit Forests, The Badgerborough, Goldleaf Garden and Firwood Water, including the Pontius' Nightmare boss, while collecting each level's vials and preparing the movement abilities needed later.

roadmap.title: Act IV — mire and grove
roadmap.description: Clear The Crackling Mire, The Blueberry Forest and The Gossamer Grove, including the Princess Zoya boss, and keep sweeping vials and hidden collectibles.

roadmap.title: Act V — the Nightmare Prince
roadmap.description: Clear Snow-Topped Heights, The Nightmare Academy and Haunted Tombs, then defeat the Nightmare Prince in the final boss level.

roadmap.title: Cleanup the collections
roadmap.description: Replay the levels that still have missing upgrade vials, Letters, Treasures or Knicknack parts. Every level can be replayed with your full ability set, and the collection screens show what is left.

achievements.description: Complete A Wintery Morning

steps.text: Play through @loc{A Wintery Morning}, free the goat stuck on the log to open the route, and reach the mailbox at the far end to complete the level.

achievements.description: Complete The Cursed Manor

steps.text: Play through @loc{The Cursed Manor} to the boss room and defeat @enemy{The Cursed Knight}: lure him into breaking platforms and roots that release light, then attack his exposed back and eyes while the light shines on him.

achievements.description: Complete A Masquerade Night

steps.text: Play through the rooftop heist of @loc{A Masquerade Night} as Zoya until the escape sequence ends and you drop outside, completing the level and Act I.

achievements.description: Complete Craghill Moors

steps.text: Reach the end of @loc{Craghill Moors} and defeat @enemy{A Giant Nightmare Wolf}: stun it with three hits from a dropped cube, an arrow or the sword, then stomp its head as Pontius; repeat six times while dodging its paw slam and summoned wolves and spirits.

achievements.description: Complete The Thorny Hedge Maze
achievements.summary: Complete the @loc{The Thorny Hedge Maze} level.

steps.text: Play through @loc{The Thorny Hedge Maze}, solve the final enemy room and see-saw door, and pass through to complete the level.

achievements.description: Complete Heatherwood Hall

steps.text: Play through @loc{Heatherwood Hall}, solve the final water-wheel area, and continue right to complete the level.

achievements.description: Complete The Prince's Dream

steps.text: Play through @loc{The Prince's Dream}. In the witch rooms, move and angle the mirrored cubes and gem blocks so the red beam reaches each receiver, then head outside to the right to complete the level.

achievements.description: Complete Moonlit Forests

steps.text: Play through @loc{Moonlit Forests}, then continue through the final cave after the last vials to complete the level.

achievements.description: Complete The Badgerborough

steps.text: Play through @loc{The Badgerborough}, solve the final key-and-crystal puzzle room, and climb the stairs to complete the level.

achievements.description: Complete Goldleaf Garden

steps.text: Play through @loc{Goldleaf Garden}, collect the final three vials after the pit, and continue right to complete the level.

achievements.description: Complete Firwood Water

steps.text: Reach the end of @loc{Firwood Water} and win Pontius' Nightmare as Pontius alone: chain Sir Cronus's mace back into him, reflect Sir Rheana's orb, and climb or jump at Sir Florianus after his spear lands, first one at a time, then two, then all three. Restart the fight if Pontius dies.

achievements.description: Complete The Crackling Mire

steps.text: Play through @loc{The Crackling Mire}, collect the final vials on the pipe and rolling ball, and continue right to complete the level.

achievements.description: Complete The Blueberry Forest

steps.text: Play through @loc{The Blueberry Forest}, collect the final vials on the track platform, and continue forward to complete the level.

achievements.description: Complete The Gossamer Grove

steps.text: Reach the end of @loc{The Gossamer Grove} and defeat @enemy{Princess Zoya}: damage her between her three orbiting objects, pull each object away with a rope arrow when its loop appears, and dodge the arrow rain after each pull. Remove all three objects to win.

achievements.description: Complete Snow-Topped Heights

steps.text: Play through @loc{Snow-Topped Heights}, then glide the final chasm with Pontius' kiteshield and continue ahead to complete the level.

achievements.description: Complete The Nightmare Academy

steps.text: Play through @loc{The Nightmare Academy}, shoot open the final door, and enter it to complete the level.

achievements.description: Complete Haunted Tombs

steps.text: Play through @loc{Haunted Tombs}, then raise and lock the ceiling block with a fairy rope, reel up via the top-left loop, and shoot the fire switch to open the door and complete the level.

achievements.description: Deal with the Nightmare Prince once and for all
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Nightmare Prince} to finish the game.

guide.context: The final level is a single boss fight in a room with recurring platforms and two ceiling hooks.

steps.text: Damage @enemy{The Nightmare Prince} while he stands still during his Laser Beam attack, and use the ceiling hooks to escape the slowly sweeping beam.
When he uses Flight Pattern he gains a shield and flies the drawn outline and cannot be hit; roll, charge or blink through his path to stay safe.
He turns red and attacks faster near one-third health; keep damaging him during the beam and avoid both attacks until he is defeated.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in A Wintery Morning
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 @item{experience vials} in @loc{A Wintery Morning}.

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count; kills award separate skill experience. The checkpoint map tracks how many vials remain in each stretch, and the level can be replayed, so a missed vial is never lost.

steps.text: Collect the vial on the icy slope, the vial further along the path, and the vial in the roots above, which you break by pushing a snowball into them or conjuring a cube.
In the first cave, pull the log stack down to climb up, take the two vials above, then cross the tracked-stone gap and stack snowballs or a cube to reach the ledge vial.
In the sticky-snow room, lower the two ceiling platforms into a ladder for one vial, then raise the lower platform to climb out for another.
Arrange the three buried planks, break the roots holding a vial with a conjured box, and use a second box to jump to the vial on the ledge.
Take the two vials floating over the sky section, the vial at the dead end, the two above the lift that the switch lowers, and the vial on the see-saw where a cube is placed.

Free the goat for the vials above the log structure, repair the broken bridge, then put a cube under the branch for three hidden vials and conjure boxes at the post to reach the last vials near the mailbox.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in The Cursed Manor
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 @item{experience vials} in @loc{The Cursed Manor}.

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count here; combat kills track separately. The checkpoint map shows the remaining vials in each stretch, and the level can be replayed.

steps.text: Take the vial on the large pumpkin, the vial past it, and the two that bounce out of the blue goo after you clear the blocking tree.
Ride the giant pumpkin into a vial, stomp through the planks into the cave for another, then use the see-saw to launch up to the three chandelier vials in the manor.
Collect the vial on the weighted platform over the poisonous mushrooms, the vial after it, then smash a crate into the ceiling so sunlight burns the webbing.
Reflect light into the roots for a vial, reflect it above a door to drop a barrel and two vials, then break the barrel for the vial inside.
Launch from the see-saw for the three vials above, break the wall left of the turret for three hidden vials, and reflect the poisonous ooze into the roots to bring down the last vial.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in A Masquerade Night
achievements.summary: Collect all 25 @item{experience vials} in @loc{A Masquerade Night}.

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count; kills track separately. The checkpoint map shows what is left in each stretch, and the level can be replayed.

steps.text: Go left before advancing for two vials, then swing the metal loops for a vial, and take the next after the three-point swing.
Flip the right switch to lower the bell and swing across, open the door below for a vial, then ride the elevator down and shoot the rope.
Pop the balloons to lower the post, then pull the cart left to open a hidden room with two vials and climb to a third on the platform above.
Pull the loop to open the trapdoor for a vial, drop below for another, then hook the cart onto the left loop.
Pull the next cart for a vial, use it to climb, and pop all three blue balloons for three vials.
Shoot the three moving targets for three vials, then build the rope bridge from the crate to the upper platform.
Pull the cart and hook a bridge for a vial, pop the gate balloons, hook the loop and reel up for a vial, then form the loop bridges for the final two vials.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Craghill Moors

guide.context: This is the longest level and only the green upgrade vials count. Use the checkpoint map to find the stretch with a deficit, and remember a missing vial can sit in the stretch before or after the one shown. The level can be replayed with your full abilities.

steps.text: Take two vials on the ground, three via the tree hook, two by weighing the branch with a cube, one past the spike bridge, and the five in the tree leaves reached with the see-saw.
Stomp the cracking bridge for a hidden vial, stomp the plank for two, pull the rock for two vials and Selius's Coronet, swing for another, then break the roots and cage for six more.
Break roots for a vial, then work the mirror-cube and light-beam rooms for grouped vials; the barrel in the lower secret cave hides seven.
Use the spinning platforms and hidden caves for more vials, and take the letter from the upper-left platform of the three-platform structure.
Fight the spirit and wolf groups for skill experience, reflect turret shots where needed, and collect the hanging and caged vial groups.
Gather the two caged vials, swing the chain for three, shoot down the hanging vials, and use the see-saw launches and rolling-ball routes for the rest.
The falling bridge holds five vials, an invisible potion group needs a charged bow shot while falling, and turret reflections release the last root-held vials before the boss.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in The Thorny Hedge Maze
achievements.summary: Collect all 120 @item{experience vials} in @loc{The Thorny Hedge Maze}.

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count. The checkpoint map tracks the remaining vials in each stretch, and the level can be replayed; a deficit may sit in the neighbouring checkpoint.

steps.text: Break the gate boards, swing over the spikes for two vials, free one from a crate, and take the two high vials before the first fight.
Move a spike block onto each wall switch, collect the three vials up to the see-saw, then launch for three more.
Clear four spiders for Zoya's element arrows, freeze platforms to reach grouped vials, and shield the turret to break the roots holding three vials.
Use the stacked see-saws, cube-powered platforms and hidden ooze caves for more vials, and collect the letter from the platform behind the 45-degree frozen platform near the bird cage.
Build the spike-wall rope bridges, drop through the trapdoor for two vials, and take the six-vial cluster on the upper-right platform.
Collect the last three vials, clear the final enemy room, and collect the second half of the Door knicknack.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Heatherwood Hall

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count; combat tracks separately. The checkpoint map shows the remaining vials per stretch, and the level can be replayed.

steps.text: Take the crate vial, the castle-stair vial, the vial through the raised-block opening, the three on the chandelier hook, and another crate vial; charge a stone into the crystal after the first fight for one more.
Use the ice-arrow platform and raft puzzles, then break the crystal wall for the five-vial hidden cave.
Work the chandelier and water-wheel rooms: cube and freeze puzzles give vials, including two above a platform and five in the water-wheel room.
Open the crystal cave for five vials and the Chandelier knicknack part, then continue the water-wheel reflection puzzles.
Solve the hidden water-wheel puzzle for seven vials and The Conjurer's Big Book of Boxes, then gather the singles and pairs in the following rooms.
Charge the large stone into the ceiling for the last five vials, then continue right to finish the level.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in The Prince's Dream
achievements.summary: Collect all 110 @item{experience vials} in @loc{The Prince's Dream}.

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count. The checkpoint map tracks the remainder in each stretch, and the level can be replayed. Portal and beam puzzles hide several groups, so sweep both sides of a room.

steps.text: Hook the chandeliers for four vials, then work the portal rooms for two vials and a stacked pair, and drop into the hidden bookshelf room for another.
Solve the mirror and beam puzzles through the manor for grouped vials, including two behind the corner wood and one in a vase.
Use the portals in the gas sections to gather the grouped vials, including three above a portal and a hidden vase vial.
Break the top-left portrait to drop five vials, then finish the arena fight it triggers.
Swing the hook spot for five vials, then freeze the platform with an ice arrow for one more.
Work the bookshelf and portal puzzles, and climb to the hidden upper-left room for five vials and a letter.
Win the outdoor arena for skill experience, break the vases for eight vials and Toby's Collar, and take the last vial above the spinning platform.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Moonlit Forests

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count, and this is one of the longest sets. The checkpoint map tracks each stretch and the level can be replayed; a deficit may sit in the adjacent checkpoint.

steps.text: Take two vials jumping the leaves, two from the bird's nest, one from the lowered platform, and the five in the hidden area behind the branch.
Win the wolf and spirit fight for skill experience, collect the leaf and box vials, and solve the glowing-stone and cube puzzles for pairs.
Build the rope bridges and use the swinging platforms and rolling balls for vials, including a five-vial cluster.
Work the mirror-cube, turret and freeze puzzles for grouped vials, then collect The Broken Dream Talisman after the seven-vial ledge.
Solve the box and platform puzzles, search the hidden caves, and gather the leaf clusters; the Chandelier knicknack part is here.
Break the roots for five vials, the crates for seven and two, then enter the last cave for the final three vials.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in The Badgerborough

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count. The checkpoint map tracks the remaining vials per stretch and the level can be replayed, so note any deficit and revisit the neighbouring checkpoint.

steps.text: Talk to the badger, freeze the first platform and climb into the tree for the first vial, then use the rope and freeze puzzles for groups of three and five.
Hook and pull the drawers and use the see-saws for their vials, then break roots and boxes for more.
Charge the rocks into the crystal walls for the five-vial groups and find the singles hidden behind planks.
Work the mushroom-platform, drawer and spin-platform puzzles, then ride the hooks for the seven-vial clusters.
Levitate the red and blue keys into their gates, then break the crystal ceilings for seven more.

Freeze the spin platform, reflect the turret shots, bounce the blue mushrooms for the last groups and the Globe knicknack part, then swing the rock through the crystal walls, place both keys in the locked door, and take the last three vials.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Goldleaf Garden

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count. The checkpoint map tracks each stretch, and the level can be replayed; plant-growing and light puzzles hide several groups, so search above and below each puzzle.

steps.text: Shoot the roots under the log for two vials, ride the grown plant's leaves for five, and shoot the two tree nuts.
Reflect water and light to grow plants for grouped vials, and search the hidden caves for more.
Bounce the blue ooze, climb the tree-top platforms and shoot nuts for scattered vials; the Globe knicknack part is in the hidden basement.
Use the dream shield to reflect water and light into plants for clusters, including a seven-vial group after the hidden basement.
Solve the hook-and-rope puzzles, search the hidden rooms and tree-nut groups, and collect A Birch Bouquet from the chest.
Raise and freeze the purple plants and reflect water for the last groups, then cross the tree bridge for the final three vials.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Firwood Water

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count. The checkpoint map tracks the remaining vials per stretch and the level can be replayed. Much of this level is underwater, so check below the surface at each water area.

steps.text: Collect the vials under the docks and underwater, build the pine-cone bridge, and use the fire switch to open the trapdoor for two more.
Bounce on the seal for three vials, ride the tree platform for five, and lock the spinning wheel with a rope bridge for another.
Search the hidden water section for six vials, then charge the ball through the crystal wall for six more.
Break the barrels and nuts and win the fights for skill experience, use the water-wheel reflection for five, and sweep the underwater routes for groups.
Use the pine-cone see-saw for eleven vials and the Globe knicknack part, gather the other groups, and collect the letter.
Work the see-saw and water-wheel puzzles for five-vial groups, search the hidden caves for seven and A Ship in a Bottle, then take the last three vials before the boss.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in The Crackling Mire
achievements.summary: Collect all 130 @item{experience vials} in @loc{The Crackling Mire}.

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count. The checkpoint map tracks each stretch and the level can be replayed. The electrified water destroys conjured and metal objects, so keep those clear of it.

steps.text: Take the four opening vials on the ground, tree and turret route, then the three on the moving platform.
Shield the turrets and reflect their shots to break the boxes for vials, then collect the five above the rope route.
Levitate the metal objects clear of the electrified water, collect the five behind the generators, and use the swing and rope routes.
Freeze the platforms between the turrets, solve the cube and rope puzzles, and search the hidden tree rooms; the letter sits at the tree top with seven vials.
Ride the ice rafts and steel ball for grouped vials, then open the hidden seven-vial area for A Piece of Amber.
Solve the floating-platform and pipe puzzles for the last groups and the Seesaw knicknack part, then collect the final two vials.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in The Blueberry Forest
achievements.summary: Collect all 100 @item{experience vials} in @loc{The Blueberry Forest}.

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count. The checkpoint map shows what is left in each stretch and the level can be replayed. The fairy rope lets you lift and freeze objects, which opens several vial routes.

steps.text: Use the rope bridges, boxes and frozen platform for the first vials, then climb to the hidden letter and five vials above the door.
Lift and freeze the platforms and logs with the fairy rope for the groups below and above the mushroom pits.
Win the wolf, spirit and hedgehog fights for skill experience, smash the log for a vial, and drop a cube into the slot.
Work the fairy-rope tracks, hidden caves and cube-stack routes, and open the seven-vial cave for Amadeus's Teddy Bear.
Solve the cage, crate and crystal-wall puzzles and the stacked-cube routes for the five-vial clusters.
Take the last two vials on the track platform.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in The Gossamer Grove
achievements.summary: Collect all 140 @item{experience vials} in @loc{The Gossamer Grove}.

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count, and the level can be replayed. The checkpoint map tracks each stretch; air-flower and waterfall puzzles often hide a group above or below the main route.

steps.text: Shoot the nut for one vial, then use the levitated metal plank to reach two more.
Ride the air flowers and reflect water for pairs and the five-vial clusters, and collect the letter from the left leaves.
Spin the wheel and solve the cube and platform puzzles, win the fights for skill experience, and search the cave and waterfall routes for seven vials and the Seesaw knicknack part.
Use the branch ropes and planks, search the hidden rooms, and charge the ball through the crystal wall for seven vials.
Stack the cubes for the last groups, open the hidden room for A Royal Tiara and six vials, and take the final vial from the last airflow.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Snow-Topped Heights

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count, and the level can be replayed. The checkpoint map tracks each stretch; sticky-snow walls, wind vents and ice rafts hide many vials off the direct route.

steps.text: Mend the bridge and jump the plank for two vials.
Use the cube platforms and wind-held cubes for pairs and five-vial groups, then drop into the hidden cave for five more.
Create ice rafts with ice arrows to reach the vials on the successive ledges.
Climb the sticky-snow planks and charge balls through the crystal walls for grouped vials; the Archivists' Filing Cabinet knicknack part is in the open pit.
After unlocking Pontius' kiteshield, glide for the groups and reflect turret shots into the crystals.
Chain the ice rafts up the waterfalls, hook the sticky-snow cubes, charge the crystal ceiling, collect the letter in the seven-vial upper area, then win the last fight and glide the final four vials.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in The Nightmare Academy
achievements.summary: Collect all 160 @item{experience vials} in @loc{The Nightmare Academy}.

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count, and this is one of the longest sets. The checkpoint map tracks each stretch and the level can be replayed; magnetic fields, lasers and portals hide groups well off the direct route.

steps.text: Climb the conjured cubes in the magnetic fields for eight vials at the first gap and five more at the top.
Open the spring doors, drop from the hooks for two vials, and bridge the platforms for four more.
Work the laser and beam rooms and the mirror-cube puzzles for grouped vials, and collect An Eerie Puppet from the five-vial area.
Solve the sun-and-moon wheel, portal and dream-shield puzzles, and search the hidden rooms for the Archivists' Filing Cabinet knicknack part and the letter.
Clear the two-wheel laser rooms and portal puzzles for the last groups, then staircase the planks and drop for the final five vials before the door.

achievements.description: Collect all experience in Haunted Tombs

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count, and the level can be replayed. The checkpoint map tracks each stretch; magnetic fields and spinning-wheel puzzles hide several groups.

steps.text: Shoot the fire switch to open the door, break the branch and the two pots for the first four vials.
Plank the wall magnetic field, freeze one of the opened doors, and break the jars for more vials.

Push the tomb and stack three cubes for the five hidden vials, win the fight for skill experience, then use the two-ball mushroom pit and the crystal ceiling for six and five more, including the final letter.
Fairy-rope the platform for one vial, launch from the see-saw for another, spin the wheel for three, and break the ceiling branches for ten more.
Solve the spinning-platform and magnetic-field puzzles for the groups, and collect An Antique Burgundy Coat and the Archivists' Filing Cabinet knicknack part.
Cross the two-turret plank bridge and collect the final five vials.

achievements.description: Collect all experience throughout Acts I-V
achievements.summary: Collect every @item{experience vial} in all 17 Act I-V levels.

guide.context: Only the green upgrade vials count, not combat skill experience. This unlocks when the last per-level vial set is completed. The checkpoint map shows remaining vials for each level, and any level can be replayed with your full abilities.

steps.text: While playing each level, open the checkpoint map and collect every upgrade vial before finishing, using the per-level hunt guides in this collection.
If a level's counter is short, replay it and sweep the checkpoint shown plus the stretches immediately before and after it, since a vial can spill into a neighbouring checkpoint.
Finish the last missing level's vial set; Experienced Hunter unlocks together with that level's own hunt achievement.

achievements.description: Collect all Letters throughout Acts I-V
achievements.summary: Collect all 14 @item{Letters} hidden across the Act I-V levels.

guide.context: One letter is hidden in each level from Craghill Moors through Haunted Tombs. The collection screen tracks them, and levels can be replayed with your full abilities, so none is permanently missable.

collectibles.name: Craghill Moors Letter
collectibles.location: @loc{Craghill Moors — spinning structure near checkpoint 4}
collectibles.method: Stand on the right side of the spinning structure, place a cube on the left side to tip it, jump to the top and then across to the left platform.

collectibles.name: The Thorny Hedge Maze Letter
collectibles.location: @loc{The Thorny Hedge Maze — hidden area past checkpoint 13}
collectibles.method: Carry a cube to the platform edge before a pit, wedging a second cube in the spike wall right, bridge a rope between them to a hidden upper area, then freeze the tilting platform at 45 degrees and climb a cube to the top.

collectibles.name: Heatherwood Hall Letter
collectibles.location: @loc{Heatherwood Hall — upper-left leaf during the checkpoint 13 fight}
collectibles.method: Defeat the checkpoint 13 enemies, then stop the upper-left leaf from sagging with an ice arrow; put a cube at its far edge and jump to the platform holding the letter.

collectibles.name: The Prince's Dream Letter
collectibles.location: @loc{The Prince's Dream — top-left hidden room from checkpoint 8}
collectibles.method: Move the bookshelf to open the route, swing into the hidden top-left room, freeze the left switch with an ice arrow, drop a box on the middle switch and hold a cube on the right switch until the door opens.

collectibles.name: Moonlit Forests Letter
collectibles.location: @loc{Moonlit Forests — upper platforms from checkpoint 11}
collectibles.method: Break the boxes and freeze the opened hatch below them, drop a ball into the pit to ride the stone platform up, then cube and hook the wall to bridge across to the letter platforms.

collectibles.name: The Badgerborough Letter
collectibles.location: @loc{The Badgerborough — rope bridge from checkpoint 3}
collectibles.method: Win the checkpoint 3 fight, drag the upper sliding platform rightward, anchor it to the moving platform, and climb the rope bridge to the path's end.

collectibles.name: Goldleaf Garden Letter
collectibles.location: @loc{Goldleaf Garden — hidden gap above the checkpoint 7 plant}
collectibles.method: At the light-beam puzzle, grow the plant to break open a small wall gap above it, stack two cubes into the gap, and climb to the hidden area.

collectibles.name: Firwood Water Letter
collectibles.location: @loc{Firwood Water — upper platform from checkpoint 14}
collectibles.method: Place a plank on the tree platform aiming upper right, place a second plank on the higher platform, link them with a rope bridge, and climb up.

collectibles.name: The Crackling Mire Letter
collectibles.location: @loc{The Crackling Mire — top of the tree from checkpoint 9}
collectibles.method: Bridge a cube to the right-wall hook and keep climbing the tree with rope bridges, using a cube on the spike wall halfway up.

collectibles.name: The Blueberry Forest Letter
collectibles.location: @loc{The Blueberry Forest — right structure before checkpoint 1}
collectibles.method: Move the tracked platform fully left to open the door, freeze it there, bridge a cube across to it, and climb the structure to the right.

collectibles.name: The Gossamer Grove Letter
collectibles.location: @loc{The Gossamer Grove — left leaves from checkpoint 3}
collectibles.method: Ride both air flowers, set a cube on the second airflow, and leap left across the leaves.

collectibles.name: Snow-Topped Heights Letter
collectibles.location: @loc{Snow-Topped Heights — crystal ceiling area from checkpoint 14}
collectibles.method: Past the door, ramp a plank on a cube and charge a ball into the crystal ceiling to open the way, then climb to the letter.

collectibles.name: The Nightmare Academy Letter
collectibles.location: @loc{The Nightmare Academy — hidden ceiling room from checkpoint 8}
collectibles.method: After the portal puzzle, lower the ceiling with two cubes on its magnetic field to open a hidden room, then link two balls in the pink mist using a fairy rope, shift the lower ball right, hit the fire switch and climb.

collectibles.name: Haunted Tombs Letter
collectibles.location: @loc{Haunted Tombs — hidden area past checkpoint 2}
collectibles.method: Past the two-ball mushroom pit, build a ramp from a cube and plank and charge a ball into the crystal ceiling, then follow the hidden area to the last letter of the game.

achievements.description: Collect all Treasures throughout Acts I-V
achievements.summary: Collect all 14 @item{Treasures} hidden across the Act I-V levels.

guide.context: One treasure chest is hidden in each level from Craghill Moors through Haunted Tombs, usually behind a puzzle or in a secret area. The collection screen tracks them and levels can be replayed, so none is permanently missable.

collectibles.name: Selius's Coronet
collectibles.location: @loc{Craghill Moors — checkpoint 1, below the cracking bridge}
collectibles.method: Move ahead until the bridge cracks and stomp through it as Pontius, drop down and pull the cube right as Zoya to reveal the chest.

collectibles.name: A Blue Quilll
collectibles.location: @loc{The Thorny Hedge Maze — cave below checkpoint 7}
collectibles.method: Hook a conjured cube to the door and levitate it right to slip in behind it, place a cube on the upper-left spiked ledge, and jump to the chest platform.

collectibles.name: The Conjurer's Big Book of Boxes
collectibles.location: @loc{Heatherwood Hall — hidden room from checkpoint 9}
collectibles.method: Climb the upper-left leaves into the cave, then use a carried cube and ice arrows on the water-wheel doors to raise the lower door and reach the chest.

collectibles.name: Toby's Collar
collectibles.location: @loc{The Prince's Dream — checkpoint 13, above the toxic cloud}
collectibles.method: Stand on the stationary centre of the spinning platform and shoot the hidden lower-left switch to open the right door, then jump in.

collectibles.name: The Broken Dream Talisman
collectibles.location: @loc{Moonlit Forests — hidden area from checkpoint 9}
collectibles.method: Top the glowing-stone puzzle, place a cube on the right stone and climb to the hidden area, then cube under the three upgrade vials, hook a rope bridge across and ball over the mushrooms.

collectibles.name: A Peculiar Stein
collectibles.location: @loc{The Badgerborough — hidden cave from checkpoint 10}
collectibles.method: Swing the hooks under the platforms into the cave with the T-shaped platform, shake it so the crate bounces free, then freeze it and climb to the upper-left chest.

collectibles.name: A Birch Bouquet
collectibles.location: @loc{Goldleaf Garden — checkpoint 15, above the purple spike plant}
collectibles.method: On the platform past the purple spike plant, freeze the plant empty with an ice arrow, stack two cubes on it, and jump to the hidden platform.

collectibles.name: A Ship in a Bottle
collectibles.location: @loc{Firwood Water — hidden cave under checkpoint 19}
collectibles.method: Cube the wooden posts and swing right under the checkpoint start into the cave, then cube the right wall and lock the spinning wheel to open the gate.

collectibles.name: A Piece of Amber
collectibles.location: @loc{The Crackling Mire — hidden cave below checkpoint 14}
collectibles.method: Enter the cave below and cube-block the water turret, bridge the post with ropes, pull out and freeze a platform, then stack cubes to the chest.

collectibles.name: Amadeus's Teddy Bear
collectibles.location: @loc{The Blueberry Forest — hidden cave from checkpoint 8}
collectibles.method: Stomp the log into the hidden cave, fairy-rope a cube to the ground loop, and levitate and bridge it under the chest platform.

collectibles.name: A Royal Tiara
collectibles.location: @loc{The Gossamer Grove — checkpoint 17 top-right platform}
collectibles.method: Climb the post with cubes, place a cube on the top-right platform, hook it with the rope arrow and reel in to climb up.

collectibles.name: A Snowglobe
collectibles.location: @loc{Snow-Topped Heights — puzzle room above checkpoint 9}
collectibles.method: Chain ice rafts up the two waterfalls, stick planks into the sticky snow, and hold a fairy-rope cube over the glow stone to cross to the chest.

collectibles.name: An Eerie Pet
collectibles.location: @loc{The Nightmare Academy — puzzle room from checkpoint 6}
collectibles.method: Stack two cubes and raise the top one with a fairy rope to the bottom cube to swing into the puzzle room, then plank the magnetic field to reach the chest.

collectibles.name: An Antique Burgundy Coat
collectibles.location: @loc{Haunted Tombs — checkpoint 7, behind the upper-right door}
collectibles.method: Place and hook a cube on the platform under the right wall, stand on the switch and use the mushroom-pit ball to launch into the open door.

achievements.description: Collect all Knicknacks throughout Acts I-V
achievements.summary: Collect all 14 parts of the 5 @item{Knicknacks} hidden across the Act I-V levels.

guide.context: Each Knicknack is assembled from parts found across different levels; collecting all parts unlocks a room and keys from the main menu. The collection screen tracks them and levels can be replayed, so none is permanently missable.

collectibles.name: Door
collectibles.location: @loc{Craghill Moors and The Thorny Hedge Maze}
collectibles.method: Craghill Moors (checkpoint 18): place a conjured cube with a plank on top to reach the upper cave on the left; skip the lower cave. The Thorny Hedge Maze (checkpoint 18): solve the door puzzle and build a ladder of multiple cubes to the open trapdoor.

collectibles.name: Chandelier
collectibles.location: @loc{Moonlit Forests, The Prince's Dream and Heatherwood Hall}
collectibles.method: Heatherwood Hall (checkpoint 11): climb the platforms above, turn the T-block down with the stone, freeze it, and charge the stone into the crystal wall. The Prince's Dream (checkpoint 11): move the top-left portrait and climb the hidden area. Moonlit Forests (checkpoint 14): freeze the right swinging platform under its glowing stone, hook both platforms, place the stone block and cube, and move the blocking stone.

collectibles.name: Globe
collectibles.location: @loc{The Badgerborough, Goldleaf Garden, Firwood Water}
collectibles.method: The Badgerborough (checkpoint 15): bounce the blue ooze right, hook across and swing to the small ceiling platform. Goldleaf Garden (checkpoint 5): break the house roots and stomp the floor planks into the basement. Firwood Water (checkpoint 8): knock the pine cone down onto the see-saw, launch up to the wall top, and shield both water wheels.

collectibles.name: Seesaw
collectibles.location: @loc{The Blueberry Forest, The Gossamer Grove and The Crackling Mire}
collectibles.method: The Crackling Mire (checkpoint 16): move the crate to the spikes, lower the platform, plank the power route to the switch and take the key. The Blueberry Forest (checkpoint 11): move the box under the dock, swim into the cave, ramp a plank and charge a ball into the crystal ceiling. The Gossamer Grove (checkpoint 7): on the air flowers below, plank up a ball and charge it left through the crystal wall.

collectibles.name: Archivist's Filing Cabinet
collectibles.location: @loc{Snow-Topped Heights, The Nightmare Academy, Haunted Tombs}
collectibles.method: Snow-Topped Heights (checkpoint 5): plank and ball the right crystal wall, then cube and ball the see-saw into the next crystal wall. The Nightmare Academy (checkpoint 13): after the sun-and-moon puzzle, reflect the light with portals and dream shields. Haunted Tombs (checkpoint 8): plank over the two turrets, pull the wall step left, freeze the middle step, and push the bottom step in.
